limitations: The extracted pair is the initial untreated silk control only. The published original main text is available through a public indexed mirror; original PDF bytes and figure pixels were not retrieved, so its evidence-cache hash is distinct from an unavailable PDF hash. The source explicitly gives control LOI 24.0% in section 3.4 and control air residue 6.8% at 600 °C in section 3.9. Figure 12 caption identifies separate nitrogen and air experiments. No nitrogen control residue is inferred from a curve. Treated samples are described as mostly losing their weight completely under air; this qualitative group statement is not converted into exact zero residues or assigned to named rows. Table 2 residue values belong to cone calorimetry and are excluded from TG fields. Exact LOIs are also reported for 2 g/L Fe/Ti treatments and 20% owf baicalin/quercetin/rutin treatments, but matching exact TG values are not established. Figure 12 uses 5% owf flavonoids with 2 g/L metal salts; 20% owf flavonoid-only LOIs are not transferred to that prepared state. Treated/mordanted LOIs are otherwise described as above thresholds or about 27%, or shown in figures; none is rounded into an exact state value. Wash durability tests at 10 and 20 cycles remain distinct from initial TG. The reported six tensile replicates, five flexural replicates and 24 h conditioning at 21 ±1 °C and 65 ±5% RH apply to mechanical tests; three replicates and eight fabric layers apply to cone calorimetry. They do not establish LOI/TG replication, conditioning or geometry. The source does not state TG pan, aliquot cutting, LOI dimensions, textile areal density or an earlier scouring procedure for the supplied control. Supplementary figures concern antibacterial/antioxidant behavior and Table S1 concerns mechanical properties; complete SI was not retrieved. A common LOI 24.0 in the earlier silk-silica study does not alone establish shared observations; that accepted source has N2 R600 33.95 with a different gas-flow method, and no exact paired match was found in source-specific screening.
pairing_evidence: Sections 2.1/2.3 define own supplied silk fabric and own TG/LOI tests. Section 3.4 explicitly assigns 24.0% LOI to original silk; section 3.9 explicitly assigns 6.8% residual mass at 600 °C to original silk in the air experiment. Neither value is a literature background datum, and no treatment/wash state is inserted between the original control assays.
